notes: New: normalized SQL reporting tables (reporting_systems, reporting_risks, reporting_cases) in aiq_cache.db, for querying the tool's data directly with plain SQL instead of json_extract() over the harvest_cache blob. Every field shown in the live UI was already persisted to SQLite (the full harvest result -- systems, risks, cases, clusters, TAM recommendations/sites/sustainability/renewals -- is stored as JSON in harvest_cache_accounts), but as one blob per account it was impractical for direct reporting. These new tables mirror the same harvest data into real columns (one row per system/risk/case), refreshed on every harvest, so tools like DB Browser for SQLite, the sqlite3 CLI, or a Python script can run normal SELECT/JOIN/GROUP BY queries against current fleet, risk, and case data. aiq_config.json (credentials/settings) intentionally remains outside the database.
